data.body: P2 IMPLEMENTED (operator-approved, no replay): T13's trigger lexicon widened from prohibition to obligation — prompt-only edit in src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T13.md (title, applicability paragraph, trigger lexicon now names additive obligations: contract/invariant/schema field/required argument/second site that must stay in step), matching wording in criteria_routing.json's T13 trigger + checklist, and docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md regenerated via the generator. The MIGRATED/EXEMPTED/UNCOVERED protocol, fail-open rule, advisory posture (block_threshold 0.95), and the audit-verbatim deterministic pre-filter regex (ticket 696a) are unchanged — the pre-gate already fires on obligation vocabulary ('now needs|requires', 'prerequisite', 'precondition'), so the router stays the applicability authority. Targeted tests (110), guide/routing parity tests (170), make lint and make typecheck all pass. Pushed as Gerrit change 2035 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2035), awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before Submit. OPERATOR EXPECTATION NOTE (recorded per ruling): approved but expected to provide minimal value given how specific the phrasing is — implemented as the cheap edit it is, no gold-plating (no det-gate regex change, no new criterion, no replay).
